title: fix(research): price dated gpt-4o-mini names with the mini rates

files.patch:
@@ -73,8 +73,13 @@ def get_model_pricing(model_name: str) -> dict[str, float]:
         return MODEL_PRICING[model_name]
     # Fuzzy matching
     lower = model_name.lower()
+    # Prefer the longest key contained in the name, so "gpt-4o-mini-<date>" is
+    # priced as "gpt-4o-mini" and not as the shorter "gpt-4o".
+    contained = [key for key in MODEL_PRICING if key in lower]
+    if contained:
+        return MODEL_PRICING[max(contained, key=len)]
     for key, val in MODEL_PRICING.items():
-        if key in lower or lower in key:
+        if lower in key:
             return val
     return MODEL_PRICING["gpt-4o-mini"]

@@ -12,3 +12,14 @@ def test_deepseek_v4_pricing_entries() -> None:
         "input": 0.000435,
         "output": 0.00087,
     }
+
+
+def test_dated_and_prefixed_mini_models_use_mini_pricing() -> None:
+    mini = {"input": 0.00015, "output": 0.0006}
+    assert get_model_pricing("gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18") == mini
+    assert get_model_pricing("openai/gpt-4o-mini") == mini
+
+
+def test_dated_full_model_keeps_full_pricing() -> None:
+    assert get_model_pricing("gpt-4o-2024-08-06") == {"input": 0.0025, "output": 0.010}
+    assert get_model_pricing("gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09") == {"input": 0.01, "output": 0.03}
